name: Amazon Prime Video
tagline: Amazon's streaming service, bundled with Prime, now ad-led with live sports
facts: 115M+ Americans see Prime Video ads monthly
TNF, NBA (11-yr deal from 2025-26), NASCAR, WNBA
Mike Hopkins, SVP Prime Video and MGM Studios
Prime ₹1,499/yr; ads since Jun 2025; MX Player merged

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Make Prime irresistible: give members premium entertainment that raises Prime retention and shopping frequency.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Be the one-stop TV destination: originals, live sports, and third-party channels in a single app.

strategy.label: Core strategy
strategy.text: Video as Prime flywheel loss-leader; ads-on-by-default monetises the huge bundled base without new subscriptions.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Prime bundle distribution, Amazon shopping data for closed-loop ad attribution, deep pockets for sports rights.

strategy.label: Key bet
strategy.text: Live sports (NBA, TNF) and Amazon MGM IP like James Bond to win premium ad dollars.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Should Prime Video be judged on its own P&L, or only on Prime retention and ad revenue it drives?

customers.who: Households already paying for Prime delivery
customers.pain: Paying separately for many streaming apps
customers.why: Video included free with Prime; no extra subscription decision needed

customers.who: NFL, NBA, NASCAR viewers in US
customers.pain: Games scattered across cable and multiple streamers
customers.why: Exclusive TNF and NBA package within existing Prime membership

customers.pain: Expensive premium OTT; wants free regional content
customers.why: Prime Lite, free MX Player content now inside Prime Video, Indian originals

customers.who: Brands, especially Amazon sellers and CPG
customers.pain: Cannot link TV ad spend to actual sales
customers.why: Amazon purchase data enables closed-loop measurement and shoppable ads

customers.who: Apple TV, HBO Max, Paramount+, local apps
customers.pain: High customer acquisition cost for standalone apps
customers.why: Prime Video Channels gives instant distribution and billing

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Not reported; ads plus subscriptions inside Amazon segments. Live sport sold out in Q2 2026.

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: Viewers pay via Prime, often not for video; advertisers pay for 315M+ monthly ad reach.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Content cost justified by Prime retention and higher basket; ads turned video into a margin line.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: NBA and sports, ads in more markets, India free tier via MX, channel add-ons.
